researchRules: Research first; do not write from memory alone.
Use official sources for dates, joins, graduations, releases and current lineups.
Use interviews and reporting to interpret turning points, but distinguish interpretation from official fact.
Include negative history without rumor or villain framing.
Treat songs as historical evidence: identify what changed in the group's identity, audience, system or performance through each key song.
Connect each group history back to the broader Hello! Project system.
